create_plot_contour_penalties: create a contour plot showing L1, L2, and elastic-net penalty level sets at value 1
build_meshgrid_penalty_surface: build a meshgrid from linspace coordinates to evaluate penalty functions on a 2D grid
plot_elastic_net_contour: plot an elastic-net penalty contour with rho=0.5 combining L1 and L2 regularization
add_contour_labels: add inline contour labels with custom formatting and manual positioning to a contour plot
style_contour_axes: style contour plot axes with centered spines and equal aspect ratio
